title: 'Find My Mouse' can be activated during 'Grab and Move' functionality, which cancels 'Grab and Move'.

steps: 1. Grab an ordinary window and move it far enough/rapidly enough to trigger Find My Mouse.
2. Record whether the grab stops and the first cancellation/focus/input transition; compare with Find My Mouse disabled.
3. Repeat across monitor boundaries, release the modifier/button and verify no input remains stuck.
4. Verify standalone Find My Mouse activation and cancellation/module-disable recovery.
reproduce.title: Trace shake-triggered cancellation of an active grab
reproduce.module: Grab And Move / Find My Mouse
reproduce.expected_result: An active grab is not canceled by unrelated pointer-location activation, and normal module activation/input recovery remain correct.
prerequisites: Controlled Windows machine; preserve both module configurations.
setup: Enable Grab And Move with the supplied modifier and Find My Mouse shake activation; use two monitors if available.

proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Find My Mouse overlay activation interrupts the grab state machine; the precise input/focus/cancellation path remains unproven.
verification: A grabbed window continues moving while Find My Mouse would otherwise activate.

Modifier/button release, cancellation and module disable restore ordinary input.
plan: Reproduce the supplied configuration and identify the first interaction cancellation transition.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve active Grab And Move gestures during Find My Mouse activation

confidence.rationale: Concrete report and supplied module configurations; no independently executed product interaction or causal trace.

evidence: PowerToys0.102.3001; the report supplies reproducible steps and a diagnostic ZIP: activating Find My Mouse while moving a grabbed window reportedly cancels the grab.
The supplied FindMyMouse configuration uses activation_method2 with shaking thresholds; GrabAndMove uses modifierKey1. Both module configurations were read from the archive.
Thirty-eight relevant text/config entries were inspected. No capture-loss trace establishes the exact cancellation mechanism.
The inspected Find My Mouse StartSonar path applies game-mode/excluded-app guards, then shows its topmost overlay. No cross-module active-grab guard appears in that path.
judgment.rationale: The report and supplied configuration support a targeted maintainer interaction reproduction, not another generic log request. Determine which grab cancellation transition fires before choosing a shared interaction-state or overlay-activation repair.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce shake-during-grab and record the precise cancellation boundary before implementing coordination.
